## Codex Credit Monitor v2.2

![Codex Credit Monitor v2.2 dashboard](https://github.com/sibosays/CodexCreditMonitor/releases/download/v2.2/dashboard-v2.2.png)

- Shows the real 5-hour reset time and remaining allowance in the dashboard status area.
- The Info window now presents the current product description with gentle pause-on-hover scrolling.
- The Windows and PortableApps packages are self-contained: no separate .NET Desktop Runtime is required.

Extract the Portable ZIP completely and run `CodexCreditMonitorPortable.exe`.

Verify the download with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. This independent utility reads local Codex session data only, sends no data anywhere, and never changes ChatGPT settings or purchases credits.
